notes.title: Oops
notes.content: Fixed a soft lock bug that got pushed with version 1.3. My apologies for that!

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.3
notes.content:
Version 1.3 Bug Fixes:

Fixed:
1. Added a player wake up animation
2. Added a player going to sleep animation
3. Added a player watering animation
4. Small dialogue changes to make references to ex more gender neutral
5. Fixed some small sprite render order bugs

[b]Thank you all for the incredible support you have shown us so far.[/b] If you notice any bugs, you will find a bug reporting discussion pinned in the discussions page.

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.2
notes.content:
Version 1.2 Bug Fixes:

Fixed:
1. Pot no longer interactable in nightmare.
2. Plant no longer interactable in nightmare.
3. Player no longer barks on the rooftop at one point.
4. Changed the coffee cup position on one day to be easier to interact with.
5. Dialogue on the rooftop no longer ends abruptly on one of the days.
6. "please" typo changed to "pleas" in nightmare scene

[b]We are about to hit 1,000 reviews with an average over 90%.[/b] Our small team of four are so happy our game has resonated with so many people, this is all so humbling.

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.1
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.1 Bug Fixes:[/b]

[b]Fixed:[/b]
	1. Ending apartment soft-lock bug
	2. Fullscreen resolution issue (fuzziness)
	3. Achievements incorrectly triggering on new game
	4. Player bed graphic still showing with player up

[b]Thank you all for the incredible support you have shown us so far.[/b] If you notice any bugs, you will find a bug reporting discussion pinned in the discussions page.
